summary.subject: Review fixes: a block type is a type from its declaration, so a type that takes a prelude name records nothing and crashes nothing; the parser recovers at an import left incomplete and at a reserved word after a statement, at the top level and in blocks, and the skipping stops at a statement on a line of its own once the failed item consumed something, so a joined line is not swallowed; a select clause separator is soft; the server ignores documents of other schemes and finds a module's open document by path; renaming an import's alias checks for clashes in its own module and goes first; completion works inside a template string's interpolation on its tokens; a field of an anonymous record type has one object per shape and name, so its references are found; a void element written without attributes is not left open in markup; defaultLibrary marks prelude names only; the workspace's files are parsed once per modification and shared by workspace symbols and the importers a rename reaches; dead code is gone
